meta.name: wiki-viewer
meta.description: Render a self-contained HTML viewer for a pro-workflow wiki. Pages, sources, claims, seed queue, page-link graph and full-text search all in one file. No external dependencies, no JS framework, S3-uploadable. Use when the user wants to browse a wiki visually, share its current state with someone, audit research progress, or hand off a knowledge base. Inspired by Thariq Shihipar's "Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML" — favors information density and shareability over markdown-only outputs.

copy.tagline: 把 wiki 渲染成可分享的 HTML 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把 wiki 内容打包成独立 HTML 文件方便分享或存档。
